title: Memory-aware rustc admission: policy, wrapper wire protocol and recorded unit observations

available.description: Admission against available host memory on top of the resident-set budget. Warden guard, warden danger and swap-out above the freeze threshold hold every start. Otherwise a unit starts when available memory is unknown or its predicted peak fits the available bytes less the margin and the unrealized share of running units. An idle broker with insufficient room starts one unit after the wait only while the warden is calm. A prior warden cancellation doubles the wait.

growth.description: Grant growth: a unit that needs more than the parent memory grant asks the host for a supplementary reservation of the difference (the fair queue of the host capacity gate decides against free memory, the warden thresholds and the interactive reserve) and waits for it at most `waitMilliseconds` (a unit that fits the grant by itself and only misses the driver's own memory waits at most `overheadWaitMilliseconds` and then runs alone with the rest of the grant), printing a progress line every `progressMilliseconds`. A unit that no memory this host can ever hold carries is queued for a larger machine; a unit that no machine of the fleet can hold is refused. `fleetDirectory` is the folder below the fleet store that holds one `memory.json` per origin.

waits.description: Visible waiting: the broker prints a progress line for every unit that waits in its queue (and for a grant growth, see `growth`) at least every `progressMilliseconds`, saying what it waits for and for how long in both languages, and hands the rows of all waiting units to its `onWaits` port every `publishMilliseconds`, so `repo capacity status` shows the stall.

bounds.description: Every client-to-broker request ends in a verdict, never in silence: a unit that waits in the broker queue is told so every `heartbeatMilliseconds` (the wrapper treats `silenceMilliseconds` without any line as a lost broker, drops the connection, and sends the request again, at most `attempts` times with a growing pause, so a request survives a broker that restarted); estimating the memory of a unit is bounded by `predictMilliseconds`; a grant growth by its own wait plus `growthGraceMilliseconds`; a unit that waits with nothing running for `stallMilliseconds` runs alone beside the budget it cannot get; a unit that waits longer than `queueMilliseconds` is refused. The Rust scheduler keeps `silenceMilliseconds` and `attempts` as constants and a test compares them.

unitCeiling.description: The compile-memory budget per worker class: the most one compile unit may hold at its peak so that it fits the smallest worker (a 16 GB Mac that runs several agents). A library unit (everything but a `cdylib`) stays within `libraryMegabytes`; only a final `cdylib` link unit may use the higher `finalMegabytes`, and it must use the serial back end. `workerClass` names the class the fleet is carved for. `carving` is the closed list of units known to exceed their budget, each with its measured peak and the reduction it waits for; the list may only shrink. Every carving entry declares `budgetMegabytes`, the budget the host warden enforces at runtime for that unit (at least its measured peak, at most 10 percent above it): a unit on the list is cancelled while it runs once its resident footprint exceeds it; an unlisted unit is cancelled above the budget of its kind. `families` is the closed list of homogeneous generated shard families (a regular expression over the whole crate name plus a target) whose per-shard peaks vary from run to run: its `measuredMegabytes` is the class measurement, the largest peak observed over any shard of the family (the `source` names the log lines), and its `budgetMegabytes` the budget every shard of the family may reach (at least the class measurement, at most 10 percent above it). A unit with its own carving entry uses that entry, else the family it matches.

UnitCeilingVerdictV1.description: The compile-memory budget applied to recorded observations: every unit above the budget of its kind (listed on the carving list or not), every carving entry that fits its budget again, and whether the ledger is within the law.

held.available: unit {unit} is held back: it needs about {predicted} MB, the host has {available} MB available with a margin of {margin} MB (warden level {level}); waited {seconds} s
held.warden: unit {unit} is held back: the host warden is at level {level} ({available} MB available, it needs about {predicted} MB); waited {seconds} s
held.swap: unit {unit} is held back: the host is actively swapping (it needs about {predicted} MB); waited {seconds} s
held.cancelled: unit {unit} was cancelled by the host warden before and is held back until it fits: it needs about {predicted} MB, the host has {available} MB available with a margin of {margin} MB (warden level {level}); waited {seconds} s

waits.queued: unit {unit} waits in the broker queue (place {place} of {count}): it needs about {predicted} MB, the {running} running unit(s) hold {held} MB of the {budget} MB budget; waited {seconds} s
waits.idle: unit {unit} waits in the broker queue (place {place} of {count}) although nothing runs: it needs about {predicted} MB, the budget is {budget} MB and the grant {grant} MB; waited {seconds} s
waits.growth: unit {unit} waits for a wider memory grant: it needs about {predicted} MB; waited {seconds} s
waits.stalled: unit {unit} waited {seconds} s with nothing running although it needs about {predicted} MB and the budget is {budget} MB: it runs alone now so that the build cannot stand still
waits.expired: unit {unit} waited {seconds} s in the broker queue, longer than the bound of {minutes} min: it is refused so that the build ends instead of waiting for ever; retry on a quieter host or a fleet worker
waits.late: unit {unit}: the broker did not finish estimating its memory within {seconds} s, the request is dropped and the compiler asks again

growth.asking: unit {unit} needs about {predicted} MB but its memory grant is {grant} MB: asking the host to grow the grant by {extra} MB (at most {minutes} min)
growth.waiting: unit {unit} still waits for {extra} MB of grant growth: it needs about {predicted} MB, grant {grant} MB, host {available} MB available, {reserve} MB reserved; waited {seconds} s
growth.grown: unit {unit}: the memory grant grew to {granted} MB after {seconds} s
growth.timeout: unit {unit} got no grant growth within {minutes} min: it needs about {predicted} MB, grant {grant} MB; the host may be busy, retry or use a fleet worker
growth.beyondHost: unit {unit} needs about {predicted} MB but this host can hold at most {holdable} MB beside its reserves: it is queued for a larger machine (the largest holds {largest} MB) and never compiles here
growth.refused: no machine of the fleet can hold unit {unit}: it needs about {predicted} MB and the largest host ({origin}) holds at most {largest} MB
growth.cancelled: unit {unit}: waiting for grant growth was cancelled after {seconds} s
growth.serial: unit {unit}: its estimate of {predicted} MB does not fit the {grant} MB grant beside the driver and no wider grant came in time: it runs alone with the rest of the grant instead of being refused or waiting for good

unitCeiling.exceeded: unit {key} peaked at {peak} MB, above the {kind} budget of {budget} MB ({class} worker class); it is not on the carving list: carve it along the domain taxonomy or declare it
unitCeiling.cold: unit {key} has no measured peak and its cold estimate is {peak} MB, above the {kind} budget of {budget} MB ({class} worker class): carve it before it builds on a small worker
unitCeiling.resolved: carving entry {crate} now peaks at {peak} MB, within its budget of {budget} MB: remove it from the carving list

held.available: Einheit {unit} wird zurückgehalten: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB, der Host hat {available} MB verfügbar bei einem Abstand von {margin} MB (Warden-Stufe {level}); {seconds} s gewartet
held.warden: Einheit {unit} wird zurückgehalten: der Host-Warden steht auf Stufe {level} ({available} MB verfügbar, sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB); {seconds} s gewartet
held.swap: Einheit {unit} wird zurückgehalten: der Host lagert aktiv Speicher aus (die Einheit braucht etwa {predicted} MB); {seconds} s gewartet
held.cancelled: Einheit {unit} wurde zuvor vom Host-Warden abgebrochen und wird zurückgehalten, bis sie passt: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB, der Host hat {available} MB verfügbar bei einem Abstand von {margin} MB (Warden-Stufe {level}); {seconds} s gewartet

waits.queued: Einheit {unit} wartet in der Warteschlange des Brokers (Platz {place} von {count}): sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB, die {running} laufenden Einheiten halten {held} MB des Budgets von {budget} MB; {seconds} s gewartet
waits.idle: Einheit {unit} wartet in der Warteschlange des Brokers (Platz {place} von {count}), obwohl nichts läuft: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB, das Budget beträgt {budget} MB und die Zuteilung {grant} MB; {seconds} s gewartet
waits.growth: Einheit {unit} wartet auf eine größere Speicherzuteilung: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB; {seconds} s gewartet
waits.stalled: Einheit {unit} wartete {seconds} s, obwohl nichts lief: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB und das Budget beträgt {budget} MB; sie läuft jetzt allein, damit der Bau nicht stillsteht
waits.expired: Einheit {unit} wartete {seconds} s in der Warteschlange des Brokers, länger als die Grenze von {minutes} min: sie wird abgelehnt, damit der Bau endet, statt ewig zu warten; auf einem ruhigeren Host oder einem Flotten-Worker erneut versuchen
waits.late: Einheit {unit}: der Broker hat die Speicherschätzung nicht innerhalb von {seconds} s abgeschlossen, die Anfrage wird verworfen und der Compiler fragt erneut

growth.asking: Einheit {unit} braucht etwa {predicted} MB, ihre Speicherzuteilung beträgt aber {grant} MB: der Host wird gebeten, die Zuteilung um {extra} MB zu vergrößern (höchstens {minutes} min)
growth.waiting: Einheit {unit} wartet weiter auf {extra} MB Zuteilungswachstum: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB, Zuteilung {grant} MB, Host {available} MB verfügbar, {reserve} MB reserviert; {seconds} s gewartet
growth.grown: Einheit {unit}: die Speicherzuteilung ist nach {seconds} s auf {granted} MB gewachsen
growth.timeout: Einheit {unit} bekam innerhalb von {minutes} min kein Zuteilungswachstum: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB, Zuteilung {grant} MB; der Host ist womöglich ausgelastet, erneut versuchen oder einen Flotten-Worker nutzen
growth.beyondHost: Einheit {unit} braucht etwa {predicted} MB, dieser Host kann neben seinen Reserven höchstens {holdable} MB halten: sie wird für eine größere Maschine eingereiht (die größte hält {largest} MB) und wird hier nie kompiliert
growth.refused: Keine Maschine der Flotte kann Einheit {unit} halten: sie braucht etwa {predicted} MB, der größte Host ({origin}) hält höchstens {largest} MB
growth.cancelled: Einheit {unit}: das Warten auf Zuteilungswachstum wurde nach {seconds} s abgebrochen
growth.serial: Einheit {unit}: ihre Schätzung von {predicted} MB passt neben dem Treiber nicht in die Zuteilung von {grant} MB und keine größere Zuteilung kam rechtzeitig: sie läuft allein mit dem Rest der Zuteilung, statt abgelehnt zu werden oder ewig zu warten

unitCeiling.exceeded: Einheit {key} erreichte {peak} MB und liegt über dem Budget {kind} von {budget} MB (Worker-Klasse {class}); sie steht nicht auf der Carving-Liste: entlang der Domänen-Taxonomie schneiden oder eintragen
unitCeiling.cold: Einheit {key} hat keinen gemessenen Spitzenwert und ihre Kaltschätzung beträgt {peak} MB, über dem Budget {kind} von {budget} MB (Worker-Klasse {class}): schneiden, bevor sie auf einem kleinen Worker gebaut wird
unitCeiling.resolved: Carving-Eintrag {crate} erreicht jetzt {peak} MB, innerhalb seines Budgets von {budget} MB: aus der Carving-Liste entfernen

fleetOnly.description: The pass is fleet-only: local compilation is refused, so a wrapper has no headroom to wait for.

ObservationV1.description: One observation of a unit key, one newline-terminated JSON line of units.jsonl; the unterminated tail of the file is an interrupted append and is dropped. Identity is (key, atMs): a later row of the same identity (the end-of-run refinement with the critical-path remainingMs) replaces an earlier one (the row appended when the unit completed, remainingMs = wallMs).

peakRssBytes.description: The larger of the unit's peak resident bytes and its largest charged sample (phys_footprint on macOS): what the OS charges the compiler with, also when its pages are compressed or swapped.

lines.description: The Rust source lines of the unit's crate directory when it was observed: the input size the peak was measured for. A forecast only uses rows whose size is within the policy tolerance of the unit's current size; rows without it are stale.

MemoryCapacityV1.description: Actual physical memory and process memory constraint; zero constraint means unknown or unbounded. Effective capacity is their minimum when constraint is positive, independent of transient free memory.

MemoryShareV1.description: Allocate the admitted CPU fraction only after effective memory and unchanged policy reserve. Never reconstruct above effective capacity when capacity is below reserve.
